evidenceSummary: Overview reconciled November 6 against current source and refreshed source-bound software qualification. All seven existing apps implement monthly/annual native subscriptions and separate non-billing 14-day local trials; real-store provisioning, signed purchase acceptance and physical-device qualification remain pending. Published optional hosting revision 5e72d2e60f9c77ab713a671b05fdedd11e7ceb0a is deliberately adopted in Skepbook, Pantry Clock, Paws and Daymerit regular builds. Skepbook composes typed selected apiaries with one workspace recipient list; Daymerit implements parent-authorized private record deletion and resumable local cleanup. Core foundation pins remain unchanged. Signed services, live licensing and physical/store release qualification remain separate pending gates. Claim Crate is consolidated into What We Own; Steward marketing source is consolidated into Hub with its prior runtime archived, while live-list reconciliation and domain cutover remain unperformed. The 27-repository inventory, 17-product queue and website publication pause remain unchanged. Earlier dated evidence retains its original scope.
